digest.component_or_area: tickets store CI fetch and rebar initialization
propositions: Fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall; --filter=blob:none reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (~15x reduction) with complete commit graph intact for merge-base queries
In Claude Code web environment, tickets fetch timeout causes rebar init to silently bootstrap a fresh orphan branch, diverging from origin/tickets and returning empty reads
Partial clone via blob:none is safe for rebar access patterns: verify-identity runs faster on blobless clone since tree-level diffs and event bodies read from working tree, not lazy blobs
Fail-open fallthrough to worktree add --orphan must be replaced with fail-closed non-zero exit when remote fetch fails
With merge.ours.driver undefined on CI runners, blob:none breaks reconverge because .bridge_state merge=ours silently degrades to 3-way text merge of 18 MB JSON
.bridge_state.bak-retarget (33 MB) sits unused in tree at HEAD and should be deleted before reclaim work
